stages.name: 参数装配与模板
stages.summary: 把模板与调用方取值合并补全成一套自洽参数——所有入口唯一的参数来源，出错在这里最贵。

stages.name: 驱动编排
stages.summary: 决定红移推进顺序与每个红移上的动作，并把逐红移结果组装成聚合形态——它是整条流水线的心跳。

stages.name: 缓存与持久化
stages.summary: 把产物按参数与红移落盘、并在重跑时判断哪些可回读——它决定长跑要不要从头再来。

stages.name: 旁路与后处理接口
stages.summary: 提供不推进主链的查询与呈现接口——主链之外的一切核对与呈现都走这里。

stages.name: 后端桥与全局前置
stages.summary: 在真正的计算之前完成后端一次性前置并负责收尾释放——没有它，后续每次调用都要重付这份代价。

stages.name: 输入与全局配置
stages.summary: 固化物理常量并登记全局参数——它是调用方不必再传参这件事的实现。

stages.name: 宇宙学背景
stages.summary: 构造线性功率谱与几何、增长量，并建好质量方差表——后续所有统计量的数值都从这里来。

stages.name: 质量函数与统计工具
stages.summary: 给出晕质量函数、塌缩分数与源质量上下限——源项与电离判据的统计底座。

stages.name: 初始条件
stages.summary: 抽样高斯随机场并实空间化，得到最早的密度与速度场——整条链唯一的随机性来源。

stages.name: 微扰场与速度
stages.summary: 把初始场推进到给定红移——没有它，后续任何阶段都拿不到该红移的物质分布。

stages.name: 晕目录与位移
stages.summary: 识别离散晕并把它位移到目标红移——源项逐晕累加那条路完全依赖它。

stages.name: 天体物理源
stages.summary: 把晕目录折算成网格上的源项——电离与 X 射线两条路都从它取源。

stages.name: 电离与复合
stages.summary: 用塌缩分数与游程集判据给出每个格点的电离状态并计入复合——21-cm 信号的空间形态由它决定。

stages.name: 热与自旋温度
stages.summary: 累积各波段辐射率并逐格点求解自旋温度——信号强度与是否可见由它决定。

stages.name: 亮温输出
stages.summary: 把密度、中性分数与自旋温度合成为亮温——主链的终点，也是唯一直接可观测的量。

stages.name: 跨阶段基建与校准
stages.summary: 提供被多个阶段共用的校准、索引、插值与调试工具——跨阶段耦合集中在这里，改它要同时想清楚所有用户。

params.name: F_STAR10
params.docstring: The fraction of galactic gas in stars for 10^10 solar mass haloes. Only used in the "new" parameterization, This is used along with `F_ESC10` to determine `HII_EFF_FACTOR` (which is then unused). See Eq. 11 of Greig+2018 and Sec 2.1 of Park+2018. Given in log10 units.

params.name: F_ESC10
params.docstring: The "escape fraction", i.e. the fraction of ionizing photons escaping into the IGM, for 10^10 solar mass haloes. Only used in the "new" parameterization. This is used along with `F_STAR10` to determine `HII_EFF_FACTOR` (which is then unused). See Eq. 11 of Greig+2018 and Sec 2.1 of Park+2018.

params.name: HII_EFF_FACTOR
params.docstring: The ionizing efficiency of high-z galaxies (zeta, from Eq. 2 of Greig+2015). Higher values tend to speed up reionization.

params.name: POP2_ION
params.docstring: Number of ionizing photons per baryon produced by Pop II stars.

params.name: M_TURN
params.docstring: Turnover mass (in log10 solar mass units) for quenching of star formation in halos, due to SNe or photo-heating feedback, or inefficient gas accretion. See Sec 2.1 of Park+2018.

params.name: PHOTON_CONS_TYPE
params.docstring: Whether to perform a small correction to account for the inherent photon non-conservation. This can be one of three types of correction: no-photoncons: No photon cosnervation correction, z-photoncons: Photon conservation correction by adjusting the redshift of the N_ion source field (Park+22) alpha-photoncons: Adjustment to the escape fraction power-law slope, based on fiducial results in Park+22, This runs a series of global xH evolutions and one calibration simulation to find the adjustment as a function of xH f-photoncons: Adjustment to the escape fraction normalisation, runs one calibration simulation to find the adjustment as a function of xH where f'/f = xH_global/xH_calibration

params.name: USE_TS_FLUCT
params.docstring: Whether to perform IGM spin temperature fluctuations (i.e. X-ray heating). Dramatically increases the computation time. Whether the minimum halo mass (for ionization) is defined by mass or virial temperature. Only has an effect when SOURCE_MODEL == 'CONST-ION-EFF'

params.name: USE_MINI_HALOS
params.docstring: Set to True if using mini-halos parameterization. If True, USE_TS_FLUCT and INHOMO_RECO must be True.

params.name: USE_UPPER_STELLAR_TURNOVER
params.docstring: Whether to use an additional powerlaw in stellar mass fraction at high halo mass. The pivot mass scale and power-law index are controlled by two parameters, UPPER_STELLAR_TURNOVER_MASS and UPPER_STELLAR_TURNOVER_INDEX respectively. This is currently only implemented using the discrete halo model, and has no effect otherwise.

params.name: USE_EXP_FILTER
params.docstring: Use the exponential filter (MFP-epsilon(r) from Davies & Furlanetto 2021) when calculating ionising emissivity fields NOTE: this does not affect other field filters, and should probably be used with HII_FILTER==0 (real-space top-hat)

params.name: INTEGRATION_METHOD_ATOMIC
params.docstring: The integration method to use for conditional MF integrals of atomic halos in the grids: NOTE: global integrals will use GSL QAG adaptive integration 'GSL-QAG': GSL QAG adaptive integration, 'GAUSS-LEGENDRE': Gauss-Legendre integration, previously forced in the interpolation tables, 'GAMMA-APPROX': Approximate integration, assuming sharp cutoffs and a triple power-law for sigma(M) based on EPS

params.name: INTEGRATION_METHOD_MINI
params.docstring: The integration method to use for conditional MF integrals of minihalos in the grids: 'GSL-QAG': GSL QAG adaptive integration, 'GAUSS-LEGENDRE': Gauss-Legendre integration, previously forced in the interpolation tables, 'GAMMA-APPROX': Approximate integration, assuming sharp cutoffs and a triple power-law for sigma(M) based on EPS
